item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly clear skies with low temperatures ranging from the lower twenties to the upper twenties and no precipitation. Tomorrow brings partly to mostly cloudy conditions with high temperatures in the low to mid fifties and only a slight chance of rain. Thursday night, skies turn mostly cloudy with lows in the upper forties and a slight chance of showers, but rainfall amounts will stay under a tenth of an inch.
